heroHeadline: Russia Demolishes Kyiv Apartment Building in Record 48-Hour Assault — 24 Killed Including 3 Children; Ukraine Strikes Ryazan Refinery, 205 POWs Exchanged
heroSubtitle: Russia unleashed the most massive aerial barrage of the war on May 13–14: 1,428 Shahed drones (a single-day record), 50+ missiles, 302 guided aerial bombs, and 3,418 artillery attacks — destroying a multi-story Kyiv apartment building and killing 24 civilians including 3 children. Mayor Klitschko called it 'the largest-scale attack on the capital.' Zelensky accused Russia of deliberately timing the assault to Trump's state visit to China. Ukraine struck back overnight with drones that set Rosneft's Ryazan refinery ablaze (~180 km from Moscow), destroying military aircraft at Yeysk and air defense systems in Luhansk and Crimea. On May 15, Russia and Ukraine completed a 205-for-205 POW exchange — a partial deliverable from the Trump-brokered ceasefire — as frontline combat surged to 257 engagements in a day. Finland's Helsinki airport closed for 3 hours after suspected Russian drone overflight alarmed the NATO Baltic flank. Russia's estimated military casualties reached ~1,346,500 since Feb. 24, 2022. Day 1,541 of the full-scale invasion.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government reports, UN monitoring missions, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical data draws on peer-reviewed scholarship. Casualty figures are contested; ranges reflect scholarly and official estimates.
